timing: written before candidate retrieval and generation

tests.criterion: One fictional adult reference-guided woman at the open cottage threshold; winter orchard visible beyond the doorway and a shared drinking bowl held by her two hands.
At least one orchard tree, its visibly attached ribbon, and a lit participant/torch trail or ritual trace must coexist in the same view; a generic indoor portrait alone fails.
Both of the woman’s hands visibly belong to her, contact opposite sides of the same bowl, and leave its rim visible.
A dark chin-length bob and separated fringe plus facial proportions plausibly resemble the supplied appearance; exact real identity cannot be established from generated pixels.
The threshold separates a warm domestic interior from a winter communal custom whose lingering presence produces unease through visible relations; mist alone is insufficient.
